messages.content: Hey, can you update my calendar for the Shenzhen trip? Boss Zhang just made another change to the schedule.
Sure thing! What's the new plan for the trip?

He finalized the decision today that the Shenzhen trip will be shortened back to two days because the extra client meeting was moved online. He also spent ten minutes complaining about the airline food from his last flight there, so I think he's relieved it's shorter.
Got it, I've updated the trip duration to two days. At least that means less airline food for him! Need me to change anything with the hotel?
No, the hotel is fine, though we were discussing how it has a really small gym. Plus, I checked the forecast and the weather during the Shenzhen trip is supposed to be rainy anyway.
Ah, that's a bummer about the gym and the rain. Might have to find another way to de-stress while you're there.
Yeah, someone joked that the Shenzhen trip would be a great excuse to just eat local dim sum instead of working out. I think I'll just take that advice!
Dim sum sounds like the perfect backup plan! Let me know if you need help finding any good spots near your hotel.

golden_memories: On 2025-09-01 Boss Zhang finalized the decision that the Shenzhen trip will be shortened back to two days because the extra client meeting was moved online.

messages.content: Hey, Wanghao and I just wrapped up some compiler optimization tests on the new MacBook. I gotta say, looking at it on my desk, I really prefer the space gray color for the new MacBook.
Space gray is definitely a sleek choice! How did the optimization tests go with the new hardware?

They went well. We got a bit distracted at first though. Wanghao noted that the new MacBook has a very smooth trackpad, and we chatted about the screen brightness of the new MacBook being too high by default. Kinda blinded us in the dark office.
Haha, the classic Apple retina burn. Once you turned the brightness down, did you get any solid numbers on the compile times?
Yeah, we finally got down to business. Wanghao concluded that after a compiler update, the new MacBook compiles the entire game client in exactly 35 seconds. It's a great improvement.
Wow, exactly 35 seconds? That's blazing fast and a nice drop from the 38 seconds he logged last week. Anything else I should note down?
Nope, that's the main takeaway. Oh, just random chit-chat, but Wanghao mentioned he wants to buy a protective sleeve for the new MacBook before he travels with it. That's all for now.
Got it. I'll remember the new compile time. Tell him good luck finding a nice sleeve, and let me know if you need anything else today!

golden_memories: On 2025-09-02 Wanghao concluded that after a compiler update, the new MacBook compiles the entire game client in exactly 35 seconds.

messages.content: Hey, the new MacBook finally arrived today. I was getting annoyed because the shipping was delayed by a day, and to top it off, the delivery driver couldn't even find our apartment building.
Oh man, gotta love delivery drama. But hey, at least it's finally in your hands! Have you unboxed it yet?

Yeah, Liwei and I were just joking about how the box for the new MacBook is surprisingly minimalist. It's practically just a plain white sleeve. She also asked me if the new MacBook feels heavier in my backpack compared to my old one.
Apple really is taking the 'less is more' approach to the extreme lately. Does it actually feel heavier when you carry it around?

A little bit, but the performance is totally worth it. Speaking of my old one, I made a serious commitment to Liwei tonight that I will pass down my old laptop to her once the new MacBook is all set up. She's been needing an upgrade.
That's an awesome hand-me-down! I'm sure she's going to love it. Do you want me to set a reminder for you to back up and wipe the old laptop this weekend?
Yeah, that would be perfect. Just remind me on Saturday morning so I don't forget to transfer my game design assets over.
You got it! I'll remind you on Saturday morning to back up your assets and prep the old laptop for Liwei. Enjoy the new rig!

golden_memories: On 2025-09-03 Linchen made a serious commitment to Liwei that he will pass down his old laptop to her once the new MacBook arrives.

messages.content: Hey, just taking a quick coffee break. I was just chatting with Sister Chen about the Shenzhen trip. I told her I really need to buy a new suitcase for it.
A new suitcase? Better grab one soon! Did Sister Chen have any good brand recommendations?

Not really, she was actually more curious and asked if we get to keep the frequent flyer miles from the Shenzhen trip. But honestly, I felt immense relief today, triggered by the news that the Shenzhen trip was shortened to two days!
That is a huge relief! Especially since you were dreading the public speaking part. Two days is definitely way more manageable.
Exactly, a massive weight off my shoulders. We also talked about the local cuisine. I told her about the spicy food I plan to avoid during the Shenzhen trip so my stomach actually survives.
Smart move! You don't want an upset stomach while you're trying to co-lead the trip and run demos. Have you started packing anything yet?
Barely started. I mentioned to Sister Chen that I still haven't packed my chargers for the Shenzhen trip. I'll probably just throw everything together tonight.
Classic last-minute packing! Just don't forget the chargers, especially with all the tech you need for the demos. Shout if you want me to generate a quick packing list.

golden_memories: On 2025-09-03 Linchen felt immense relief, triggered by the news that the Shenzhen trip was shortened to two days.

messages.content: Hey, I need to update my plans for the weekend dinner. Mom just called me.
Sure thing. What's the update? Still doing hot pot?
Actually, no. I promised Mom I'd prepare handmade dumplings instead of hot pot for the weekend dinner. She was super excited and said she even bought new napkins specifically for it.
Got it, switching from hot pot to handmade dumplings. That sounds delicious. Need me to add anything to your grocery list?
Yeah, add flour, ground pork, and cabbage. I also mentioned to her that the parking situation might be tough during the weekend dinner, so they should probably try to get here a little early.
Added to the list, and noted on the parking warning. Anything else you guys talked about?

She asked if the air conditioning is working well enough for the weekend dinner since it's been so hot lately. I assured her it's fine. We also discussed the background music playlist I set up for the dinner, so the vibe should be perfect.
Sounds like you've got everything totally under control. AC, dumplings, and a great playlist. Let me know if you need help prepping anything else!

golden_memories: On 2025-09-04 Linchen promised Mom he would prepare handmade dumplings instead of hot pot for the weekend dinner.

messages.content: Hey, Jiange just texted me about the weekend dinner. He changed the pickup time.
Got it! What time is he picking you up now?
He rescheduled picking me up for the dinner to 6:30 PM instead of 6:00 PM. He mentioned he needs to wash his car before driving over.
Makes sense. I'll update the pickup time to 6:30 PM. Anything else I should note?
Not really, though he was complaining about gas prices while talking about driving to the weekend dinner. I just replied that I hope the traffic isn't too bad on the way there.
Traffic and gas prices, the classic driving combo! Hopefully, the roads are clear for you guys.
Yeah, fingers crossed. We actually joked about wearing matching gym shirts to the weekend dinner just to be funny. Anyway, that's all the updates for now.
Haha, matching gym shirts would definitely make a statement! I've got the new 6:30 PM pickup time saved. Let me know if anything else comes up.

golden_memories: On 2025-09-04 Jiange rescheduled picking up Linchen for the weekend dinner to 6:30 PM instead of 6:00 PM.

messages.content: Hey, let's log some notes for the next customer demo. I just had a quick debrief with Boss Zhang about the last one. We actually had a good laugh about a typo someone made in the invitation email for the customer demo.
Sure thing! Glad you guys could laugh about the typo. What do we need to note down to make the next demo smoother?

Well, for logistics, I pointed out that the font size in the slides for the customer demo was way too small. Also, the projector cables were a total mess during the last customer demo, so I need to fix that. Oh, and Boss Zhang mentioned we should order better coffee for the next customer demo.
Got it. Bigger fonts, better cable management, and upgraded coffee. Good practical tweaks. Did Boss Zhang make any official calls on what content you'll actually be presenting?
Yeah, that's the main thing to record. Boss Zhang decided that the next customer demo will feature the newly designed multiplayer lobby. We need to make sure the build is fully polished.
Awesome, I've noted Boss Zhang's decision to feature the new multiplayer lobby. Anything else you need me to track for the upcoming showcase?
Nope, that's all for now. I'm going to start prepping the lobby assets so everything is ready to go.
Sounds like a solid plan. Just give me a shout if you need help organizing those assets later!

golden_memories: On 2025-09-05 Boss Zhang decided that the next customer demo will feature the newly designed multiplayer lobby.

messages.content: Hey, can we log some notes from the customer demo today? Boss Zhang already said the next one will feature the new multiplayer lobby, but Wanghao and I just had a debrief on how today's went.
Sure thing. What were the main takeaways from you and Wanghao?
Well, first off, Wanghao was complaining that the room temperature was way too cold during the demo. And honestly, the snacks they provided were totally stale.
Yikes, a freezing room and stale snacks isn't exactly the VIP treatment. Did you guys get into the actual game performance?

Yeah, we discussed the color palette of the UI we showed, just to see if it needs tweaking for contrast. But the big technical takeaway from Wanghao was his conclusion that the client memory usage during the customer demo peaked at 1.2GB.
Got it. 1.2GB peak memory usage is definitely an important metric to track. Anything else from the debrief?
Just that Wanghao mentioned his chair was squeaking the whole time during the customer demo, which was super distracting. That's pretty much it for the notes.
Sounds like quite the experience! I've got the memory usage metric logged. Let me know if you need to prep anything for that new multiplayer lobby demo.

messages.content: Hey, the weekend dinner with Mom just wrapped up. It went pretty well! We ended up making those handmade dumplings I promised her.
Nice! I bet the dumplings were a hit. How did everyone get along?
Really well, actually. Liwei was pleasantly surprised during the dinner because Mom went out of her way to praise her new haircut. It set a really great mood for the night.
That's awesome! A compliment from mom always wins points. Did the food turn out perfect too?
Mostly! Liwei did mention that the soup was a bit too salty, and I accidentally spilled a drop of soy sauce on the tablecloth, but it wasn't a big deal.
A tiny soy sauce spill and salty soup are practically required for a family dinner. What did you guys chat about?
We just talked about this funny TV show we've been watching while eating. Oh, and Mom also asked where we bought the plates we used for the dinner. She really liked the design.
Sounds like a super relaxing, normal family night. Glad the weekend dinner was a success!

golden_memories: On 2025-09-06 Liwei became pleasantly surprised during the weekend dinner when Linchen's mom praised her new haircut.

messages.content: Hey, I just caught up with Jiange to figure out our workout routine now that the Shenzhen trip is wrapped up. He actually asked if I bought any cheap electronics during the trip.
Welcome back! Did you end up finding any good tech deals, or were you too busy?

Too busy, honestly. Though I did tell him I saw a lot of electric taxis while on the Shenzhen trip, which was pretty cool. Jiange mentioned he has a friend who also recently came back from the Shenzhen trip, so we were comparing notes.
That's awesome, electric taxis are definitely taking over there. Did you guys manage to lock in a time to hit the gym?
Yeah, we did. Jiange scheduled a recovery workout session for the Monday immediately following the Shenzhen trip at 7:00 AM.
Got it. 7:00 AM this coming Monday for a recovery workout with Jiange. Sounds like a great way to shake off the travel fatigue. Anything else to add?
Not really for the schedule. We mostly just joked about me getting lost in the subway system during the Shenzhen trip. Those stations are massive! Just make sure that 7 AM workout is logged.
All set! Your 7:00 AM recovery workout with Jiange is on the calendar. Hopefully, the gym is easier to navigate than the Shenzhen subway!
